title: Strip execution hooks from tracker commands
description: graph.go's dispatch block and update.go's wave-width claim gate read [orchestration].max_parallel via internal/runnersconfig; frontier.go (and tk close's continuation verdict) reads .tick/logs/herd manifests and RESULT files via herd/state; tk next --autonomous and policy.autonomous_mode are runner paths. Remove them; keep role, awaiting (incl. checkpoint), EPIC-SKELETON and wave Compute for display. Delete runnersconfig and herd/state and wave's InFlight/Admission once unused. Decide tk frontier's fate: keep it only if it still means something without herd evidence, else delete it.
acceptance_criteria: [A2] of the epic; no tracker command imports runnersconfig or herd/state; graph --json still reports waves, missing_process_ticks and readiness; tests for role/awaiting/skeleton pass.
